newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sime to buy remaining stake in Solarvest.
newsitem.headline: Sime to buy remaining stake in Solarvest.

text.p: Malaysian conglomerate Sime Darby Bhd said on Tuesday it has agreed to acquire the remaining 35 percent equity in Solarvest Sdn Bhd which it does not own, for 33.5 million ringgit cash.

Sime said in a statement that upon completion of the acquisition, the group would provide sufficient inter-company loans to enable Solarvest to discharge advances made to it, amounting to about 46.2 million ringgit.
Solarvest owns and manages the Kuala lumpur Golf and Country Club. It also owns about 71 acres of vacant land adjoining the club which have been approved for development into residential properties.
